description: Hand-curated cross-check anchors for the adjustment function. Each event's raw close prices are fetched from TWSE's official STOCK_DAY endpoint; dividend amounts are from TSMC SEC 6-K filings and TSMC IR. Sources deliberately independent of FinMind. The `expected_adj_close_ratio` field is the value the test asserts directly (X / (Y + D)), not the textbook back-adjustment factor (Y / (Y + D)). See journal/decisions/2026-05-13-adjustment-cross-check-method.md.
